intro:
The way a piece moves: (un)safe

Your task is under the board: for which pieces can you point out the safe and the unsafe squares, or the right captures and the wrong captures?

Place the plus and minus signs on the correct squares (in case of a capture on the piece).
A plus for a safe move and a minus for an unsafe move.

You can easily correct any mistakes by changing the plus or minus sign.

When you are finished, click on [OK].
